page_title: HOF 5-1 MON | Hoffenheim v B. Monchengladbach 14/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch for Lukas Ullrich.

88' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
87' The free kick from long range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) brought his opponent down.
84' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Fisnik Asllani will be replaced by Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim).
81' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
80' Hoffenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
79' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

77' 5 - 1 It's a goal! Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) makes it 5:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Valentin Gendrey and planted his close-range header low into the middle of the goal. Moritz Nicolas was helpless.
77' Christian Ilzer has decided to make a change. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) replaces Tim Lemperle.
76' That's the end of the game for Bernardo, who is replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
75' Rough tackle by Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
70' The attendance for today's match is 20750.

69' 4 - 1 Goal! Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Rocco Reitz inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 4:1.
69' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Haris Tabakovic and he is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
69' Today's match ends for Jens Castrop who will be replaced by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
67' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
66' Vladimir Coufal looks up and plays a clever lofted ball onto the head of Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim), who sends the ball narrowly wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
66' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
64' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Alexander Prass will be replaced by Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim).
64' Here comes a substitution. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Wouter Burger.
62' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.

61' A neat pass finds Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann denies him with a good save.
60' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:4.
58' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) commits a foul during an attacking move.
58' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

57' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hoffenheim are going to take it.

57' Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Oliver Baumann makes a comfortable save.
56' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Franck Honorat.
56' A lofted cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
55' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Neat passing move from Hoffenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.

51' Moritz Nicolas was forced into action to thwart Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
48' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) produces a mid-range free kick, but fails to find the target. He curled the ball over the wall but his shot goes way wide of the left post.
47' Christian Dingert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach). Hoffenheim win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' Eugen Polanski has made a change at the break. Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) has come on in place of Yannik Engelhardt.
46' Referee Christian Dingert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' 4 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 4:0.
45+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+1' 3 - 0 Goal! Fisnik Asllani gets to the ball, slips Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:0.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Christian Dingert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
42' Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
41' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
39' The game is interrupted now, Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from B. Monchengladbach was in an offside position.
37' 73:27 – the ratio of ball possession.
34' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
34' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

33' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
32' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.

32' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
29' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

27' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.

24' 2 - 0 Goal! Fisnik Asllani produces a great pass that finds Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Moritz Nicolas into the bottom left corner.
22' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' The Hoffenheim players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

20' Play continues despite the shouts by some Hoffenheim players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Christian Dingert interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
19' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

18' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
15' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
13' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
12' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
10' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
8' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
8' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

8' Great save! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the top left corner was brilliantly saved by Moritz Nicolas. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
7' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The free kick from long range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
5' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

4' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Oliver Baumann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
4' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
4' The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
3' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Hoffenheim win a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert will supervise the game today.
